routes.label: enrolment with the National Identification Registry

note: DUBAWA's fact-check, quoting the NIR's director of communications and its service charter: a Liberian citizen's card costs US$5 (ECOWAS residents 10, others 20), confirmed by applicants' receipts; the fee is in US dollars, as charged. The age it's issued from, its term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: DUBAWA, False! Fee for Liberia's national ID card has not increased
sources.said: “We don’t charge such an amount. The citizen card is US$5.” ... The NIR’s fee structure is as follows. Liberian Citizens: US$5 ECOWAS Residents: US$10 Non-ECOWAS Residents: US$20
